verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, so automatic sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack, which covers card payments, captures, refunds, 3DS, network tokens, recurring charges, payouts, POS and llms.txt probes, documents automatic tax calculation or collection on transactions.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically
